author: coconutcockpit
description: Andersen Air Force Base airfield complex in Guam with 12 aircraft groups including B-52H, B-1B, F-15E, F-16C, and A-10C, plus ground support elements, cargo containers, fuel depots, and air defense systems (Patriot, Vulcan, Avenger) suitable for large-scale strike operations or multiplayer campaign scenarios.
